notes.title: UPDATE 1.13
notes.notes:
Discover the new secrets of the VHS with the new video available in an area of the game you jumped through ;)

This new version brings the following improvements
- Video execution in parkour level
- Restart at the house level if you do the secret path on the roof.
- More lighting and guidance in the real ending
- DualS Easter Egg (I had to do it xD)
- New video in Extras
- VHS Menu bug during Hospital
- Safety restart if you fall off the map

If you find bugs report it to "Astral Dream Team" and enjoy this new version of "VETITUM_VRC".

notes.title: OFFICIAL RELEASE OF VETITUM_VRC
notes.notes:
VETITUM_VRC - Now Available!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171030/d2337296f3a8c9cf3f042b7a9878264f4aaf5e7d.png


Immerse yourself in the haunting atmosphere of VETITUM_VRC and explore a collection of videotapes containing multiple endings, each revealing fragments of a hidden story. In this game, nothing is what it seems, and you are part of the investigation.

Delve into the dark forest of Flemmywoods, where you will find clues to a mysterious event that someone is trying to cover up. In a chaotic night, secrets intertwine, and your mission will be to uncover the truth. Do you dare to solve the case with us?
